title: Operator decisions are kept, scoped and cited in the kb
goal: Operator decisions are kb content: every root and kb/_self may keep _decisions.csv and decision-makers.csv, with kb/_self/decision-makers.csv the central register; facts cite decisions with a DECISION tag; agents only propose and the operator confirms; a decision tied to a work item, fact, source, article or domain is invalidated with its reason when that context is, and its row stays in its file; lookups show active and proposed decisions beside facts, and audit lists contradicting ones.
notes: Scope: a decision may override, add to or do anything else to the facts of its context; no rule constrains that relation. review_by is optional. The query log treats decision lines like the facts of their root. Out of scope: decisions or task markers in code, comments or tests (DECISION is kb content only); new dependencies.
